profile.notes: Ficha separada de la Hermandad de la Trinidad aunque ambas comparten entorno salesiano y sede en María Auxiliadora.
profile.history_text: La asociación de devotos de María Auxiliadora de la Casa Salesiana de la Santísima Trinidad fue aprobada y agregada a la Primaria de Turín el 24 de mayo de 1896, un año después de la llegada de la imagen mariana a Sevilla.

profile.official_name: Hermandad del Santísimo Sacramento, Gloriosa Resurrección de Nuestro Señor Jesucristo, María Santísima de la Alegría y Santa María Magdalena

read_queries:
select now() observed_at,(select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) migrations,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'name',e.name,'slug',e.slug,'status',e.status,'profile',to_jsonb(b)) order by e.id) from public.entities e join public.brotherhoods b on b.entity_id=e.id where b.municipality_id='e4319248-831a-4f4c-adb8-19c496f95dd6') utrera,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'name',e.name,'slug',e.slug,'profile',to_jsonb(b))) from public.entities e join public.brotherhoods b on b.entity_id=e.id where e.name ilike '%auxiliadora%' or e.name ilike '%marisma%' or e.name ilike '%resucitado%') classification_examples,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',table_name,'column',column_name,'data_type',data_type,'udt',udt_name,'nullable',is_nullable,'default',column_default) order by table_name,ordinal_position) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name in ('entities','brotherhoods','images','steps','outings','agents','places','sources','source_links','entity_locations','brotherhood_images','brotherhood_steps','step_images','heritage_assets','heritage_asset_agents','entity_agents','bands','music_accompaniment_periods','outing_steps','outing_music_accompaniments','outing_images')) schema;

select jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),
'entities',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) order by id) from public.entities e),
'places',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by id) from public.places p),
'municipalities',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'slug',slug) order by id) from public.municipalities),
'brotherhoods',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) order by entity_id) from public.brotherhoods b),
'bands',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) order by entity_id) from public.bands b),
'agents',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('entity_id',entity_id,'agent_kind',agent_kind,'description',description) order by entity_id) from public.agents),
'sources',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) order by id) from public.sources s)
) as data
